description: This is a Java source file implementing the HibernateContextDAO class, which provides Hibernate-specific database operations for OpenMRS, including session management, user authentication, cache management, and search index updates.

classes.name: HibernateContextDAO
classes.description: Hibernate specific implementation of the ContextDAO interface, providing methods for session management, user authentication, cache control, and search index management in OpenMRS.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory used by this DAO.

methods.name: setUserDAO
methods.description: Sets the UserDAO dependency.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user by username and password, managing lockouts and login attempts.

methods.name: getUserByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a User by their UUID.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves a User by their username.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new User with the specified password and roles.

methods.name: saveUserProperties
methods.description: Persists updates to a User's properties.

methods.name: getUsersLoginAttempts
methods.description: Retrieves the number of login attempts for a User.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Opens a Hibernate session and manages participation in existing transactions.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes the Hibernate session and unbinds it from the transaction manager.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears the current Hibernate session cache.

methods.name: evictFromSession
methods.description: Evicts an object from the current Hibernate session cache.

methods.name: evictEntity
methods.description: Evicts a specific entity instance from the Hibernate cache.

methods.name: evictAllEntities
methods.description: Evicts all entities of a given class from the Hibernate cache.

methods.name: clearEntireCache
methods.description: Clears all Hibernate second-level cache regions.

methods.name: refreshEntity
methods.description: Refreshes an entity from the database.

methods.name: flushSession
methods.description: Flushes the Hibernate session.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Initializes the context; no implementation logic here.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Closes sessions and the factory, and logs statistics.

methods.name: showUsageStatistics
methods.description: Logs Hibernate cache and query statistics.

methods.name: mergeDefaultRuntimeProperties
methods.description: Loads default Hibernate properties and merges with runtime properties.

methods.name: updateSearchIndexForType
methods.description: Reindexes all entities of a given class type.

methods.name: updateSearchIndex
methods.description: Reindexes all entities of specified types.

methods.name: updateSearchIndexForObject
methods.description: Reindexes a single object.

methods.name: setupSearchIndex
methods.description: Checks and updates the search index version.

methods.name: updateSearchIndex
methods.description: Performs a full reindex of all entities.

methods.name: updateSearchIndexAsync
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous full reindex.

methods.name: getDatabaseConnection
methods.description: Provides a JDBC connection to the database.
